b.x: Survivalism
Ordinary margin for when the street stops: water, food that turns, a head, a family plan. Not a bunker and not war talk.
FIFO
First in, first out: what enters the pantry first leaves first. A turn against dates, moths, and humidity.
FEFO
First expired, first out: what expires first leaves first. Tape on the lid. FIFO by purchase alone leaves the old lot rotting behind. Three-clocks field.
Emotional intelligence
Treat feeling as data, not as an order. Four branches: perceive, use, understand, manage. A narrow name. No diploma. No social weapon. Field 93.
72 hours
Three days to leave, wait, or reach a safe point. It is not for living in the woods forever.
Cooper (white / yellow / red)
A scale of attention. White: screen in the face. Yellow: relaxed and on — you can spend the day here. Red: act, no speech.
Contact surface
How much of you the room sees, hears, and keeps: look, voice, digital, stock in the window. Gray reduces surface.
Emergency numbers
Brazil: 190 police, 192 ambulance, 193 fire. On the tongue, not at the bottom of the bag. Abroad, note the local number before the trip.
Digital gray man
Reducing surface on the network: photo, location, status, a Bluetooth name. The same sidewalk doctrine — boring on purpose.
Gray man theory
The discipline of least attention: the place’s rhythm, less surface, not being picked first. Not militia and not vanishing from the law.
14-day island
Household margin for a stopped street: water, food that turns, hygiene, paper on the fridge. Not a bunker.
Gray light
One low torch, away from the window. A screen that does not stick to the glass. Several candles are a fire and a poster.
Digital footprint
What a stranger assembles in five minutes: name, neighborhood, routine, people in the house. Gray shrinks the footprint.
Gray uniform
There isn’t one. Earth, beige, and 5.11 in the center is costume. Wear what that street wears at that hour.
Three layers
Look, behavior, information. If one shouts, the other two will not save you.
Spotlight effect
You feel more seen than you are. Performing for the spotlight — a stiff neck, an operator’s gaze — is the poster.
Inattentional blindness
The brain does not file what confirms the room’s mold. Gray fits the guess. Deviation gets a card.
Looked but failed to see
The retina received. The file did not write. Tuesday’s accident is almost never ‘I didn’t look’.
Inattentional blindness
Lab name for looking without filing. Mack and Rock. Simons and Chabris’s gorilla. Not a cloak.
Black gorilla
Whoever counts the black team misses the gorilla more often. Similarity to the set becomes noise — not a switch.
Change blindness
Failing to notice that something changed — the other person, the sign, the room. Sister of inattentional blindness. Not a cloak.
Inverted gorilla
The gorilla video does not teach vanishing. It teaches not to be the event. Gray wants to be the pass, not the gorilla.
Selective attention
The beam that chooses what enters the file. Inattentional blindness is what was left outside.
Cocktail-party effect
Your own name punches the noise. That is why the mouth prints more than the bag — and one free ear hears whoever you love.
Gray typography
The lettering you carry. Wear that street’s type at that hour. Forum stencil is a résumé.
Letter audit
Five minutes at the door: chest, back, bag, lock screen, Bluetooth. What asks for a sentence comes off.
Start gray
A thirteen-stop trail. Map, filter, Tuesday. One field per commute. Without buying molle.
Tuesday rule
One field, one commute, one change that fits. If it does not survive the bus, it is still costume.
Vibrational frequency
The tone in which nerves, attention, and feeling coincide. Not laboratory hertz. Fear locks at 100. Courage starts at 200.
Process visualization
Mental rehearsal of the hand, not the applause. Key, shoe, a short sentence. If it becomes a hero film, cut.
Fear is a magnet
What you hold with intensity organizes around you. Fear calls fear. Not punishment — resonance. Change the station: relief, gratitude, presence.
Law of attraction
Tone + attention + hand. The shop window sells the object. Gray chooses the station and makes the gesture. Nobody ‘attracted’ the flood.
Cape, not skin
Discretion in the street is a cape. Erasing yourself is skin. The craft asks for the first. The second is fear’s magnet.
Psychological abuse
A pattern that humiliates, isolates, controls, or erases what the person saw, until the house shrinks. It is not one fight. 180, 100, 190. The craft does not cover it.
Gray alpha family dynamic
On Tuesday, two adults. At the hour, a sentence that ends. The child is not a sentinel. A house that speaks lower when he arrives has already shrunk.
Gray alpha psychology
Duty without an audience. Not a caged wolf. Exhibitor, covert, and anxious controller use the same name. A house that shrinks tells on it.
Gray alpha man
He decides for the house and does not ask for the pack. The network alpha is a stage. This one holds the line and passes on the sidewalk.
Gray sigma man
Outside the pack and outside the spotlight. Free without shouting. The street’s law still holds. Not a robot.
Archetype’s shadow
Using the craft in order not to pick yourself. “Just being gray” becomes an alibi. The cape stays. The skin leaves.
Hertz table of emotions
Hawkins’s map: shame 20, fear 100, anger 150, pride 175, courage 200, reason 400, love 500, peace 600. A state clock, not a spectrometer.
Co-creator
What attention rehearses, the body lives. Fear asks for proof and the street delivers. Gray rehearses margin, not the end.
Emotional intelligence
Feeling without being driven: name it, separate fact from film, one breath, one step up the table.
Shield, not a sword
Stage laws read backwards. Defense against the ask. Using them as a sword is becoming the stage.
Falsifier
What would make me drop this sentence. If nothing would, it is dogma, not craft.
Next question
The craft against the stage. Faith that survives stays. Dogma that dies was the stage’s. The Matrix is the automatic yes.
Fast warning
The body’s shortcut (amygdala) fires before the sentence. Useful if it hands over to the slow: a name, breath, three facts. At the wheel, it is Apocalypse on the bus.
Emotional cluster
Three channels on the same ask (speech, flash, body). Congruent, incongruent, or mixed. One word, not a report.
Leakage
What speech, flash, or body let go against the ask. Not proof. It counts in a cluster of three.
Gray posture
Neither operator nor prey. Weight on both feet, a low shoulder, hands visible and ordinary. The resident’s body.
Microexpression
A short flash on the face before the mask. Not proof. It counts in a cluster with the ask and the distance.
Mismatch
The mouth says one thing; the ask, another. A smile and a map question. Haste with no danger in the room. There is the intent.
Too sweet
In chaos, the meekness that closes distance and asks for your story. Bait cheaper than a threat. Watch, don’t explain.
Cell broadcast alert
An authority warning that still reaches the phone when the network is clogged. Do not mute the emergency channel.
River mark
A trigger written on a Tuesday: the step, the brick, the fence. When water touches it, the house is already on the path. You do not wait for the living room.
Mindfulness
Attention in the room that exists: air, foot, sense. No incense. On the street, eyes open.
Gray habit
A repeated craft without a stage: move the body, read, a short plate. Motivation vanishes; the clock stays.
Dense food
Calorie and micronutrient in the smallest volume: liver, sardine, egg, tuber, a named fat. Not a shop-window miracle.
Automatic sync
Matching text and voice on the same clock. A factory mark (VTT) or a letter-guess. No cloud with the field voice.
STOP (lost)
Sit, think, observe, plan. Do not run. Three whistles. Water before food. Whoever stayed at camp does not scatter the group.
Best first-aid kit
What the family finds in the dark, still in date, and the hands already drilled. Corner pharmacy, not an IFAK. A course is worth more than the brand.
Survival kit
A system, not a pack: EDC in the pocket, a 72 h bag that looks like travel, a 14-day island at home. Water before the can.
First-aid kit
The household box: barrier, gauze, saline, paper, medicine the law already gave. Pocket and bag are smaller layers. No tactical vest.
AED / CPR
Automated external defibrillator and resuscitation. Gray maps the building’s AED. Compression is taught on a dummy, not on a screen.
Civilian survival rules
Twelve Tuesday rules: law, STOP, threes, island, emergency numbers, ID, no poster, point B, light and people, do not chase, one correction, fear off the wheel.
SERE
Survival, Evasion, Resistance, Escape. Training for the isolated in conflict. In civilian life only the S crosses: water, shelter, signal. E, R and E do not become a bus craft.
STOP
Sit, Think, Observe, Plan. Stop before spending water on panic. FM 21-76, public.
OPSEC
Operations Security (AR 530-1): what must not leak, who would benefit, where it already leaks, the risk, Tuesday’s boring countermeasure.
Soft target / hard target
Soft: obvious routine, a symbol, isolation, the stage. Hard: ordinary, people and light, a last block that does not fit a sticker.
IPM
Individual Protective Measures: AT Level I’s boring movement list. Wear the environment. Do not discuss the itinerary in the taxi. The number on the tongue.
Neural translation (NMT)
A network that predicts the next token of the target sentence. Transformer, attention, BPE. High fluency, meaning sometimes invented. The cloud is a witness; a pack on the device reduces surface.
Transformer
2017 architecture: parallel attention instead of an RNN. Floor of current translators. Scales fluency. Does not scale truth.
Offline translation
Language on the device, no tower. Less witness, works in a blackout, no quota or login. A pack downloaded at home; field lexicon in this guide.
